subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Blessing in disguise

options.text: Something that seems good but is harmful for you
Something that seems bad but provides some benefit
Something that cannot be hidden from anyone
Something that remains hidden from everyone

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Blessing in disguise"** means **something that seems bad but provides some benefit**. (छलावरण में आशीर्वाद)

 
 
• **Example:** Losing that job was a **blessing in disguise**; it pushed me to pursue my passion.
 
 
 
• **Explanation:** The idiom refers to a situation that appears negative at first but ultimately results in something positive.
 
 
• **Example:** Missing the bus was a blessing in disguise because I met my future business partner while waiting for the next one.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1:** Something that seems good but is harmful for you (ऐसी चीज़ जो अच्छी लगती है लेकिन आपके लिए हानिकारक होती है)

 
 
• **Example:** The free trip seemed great, but it was actually a scam to steal personal information.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** Something that cannot be hidden from anyone (ऐसी चीज़ जो किसी से छिपी नहीं रह सकती)
 
 
• **Example:** The truth about his actions could not be hidden from anyone.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** Something that remains hidden from everyone (ऐसी चीज़ जो सभी से छिपी रहती है)
 
 
• **Example:** The treasure remained hidden from everyone for centuries.
